items.exampleEn: Visitors can submit their ideas for the new park on the city website.
items.exampleZh: 民眾可以在市府網站上提出新公園的點子。

items.exampleEn: The extension of the subway line will open next year.
items.exampleZh: 捷運的延伸路段明年將會通車。

items.exampleEn: Shrugging your shoulders can mean "I don't know."
items.exampleZh: 聳聳肩可以表示「我不知道」。

items.exampleEn: The small station cannot cope with so many travelers during the holidays.
items.exampleZh: 那個小車站在假期時應付不了這麼多旅客。

items.exampleEn: The flames of the fire kept us warm all night at the camp.
items.exampleZh: 營地裡的火焰讓我們整晚都很溫暖。

items.exampleEn: A single grain of rice fell on the table.
The whole evening was devoted to music and dancing.
items.exampleZh: 整個晚上都用在音樂和跳舞上。

items.exampleEn: She passed the difficult exam with ease.
items.exampleZh: 她輕鬆通過了那場困難的考試。

items.sentenceEn: Please submit your application form before the end of the week.
items.sentenceZh: 請在本週結束前繳交申請表。

items.audioEn: The new bridge should ease traffic in the city center during rush hour.
items.audioZh: 新橋應該能紓解尖峰時段市中心的交通。
items.questionZh: 新橋預計會有什麼效果？
options: Less traffic downtown at busy times

items.sentenceEn: She shrugged when I asked where she had put the keys.
items.sentenceZh: 我問她鑰匙放在哪裡，她聳了聳肩。

items.sentenceEn: A candle flame moved gently in the wind.

items.stemEn: The hotel is building a new ____ with twenty more rooms.
items.stemZh: 那家飯店正在蓋一棟多二十間房的新擴建樓。

items.stemEn: She ____ most of her free time to helping at the animal shelter, even on holidays.
items.stemZh: 她把大部分的空閒時間都投入在動物收容所幫忙，連假日也不例外。

items.passageEn: Ming is a university student who had to submit a long report on rice farming by Friday. Her grandfather had devoted his whole life to growing grain, so she chose the topic. But the project was harder than she expected, and she was struggling to cope with all her classes. On Wednesday, she asked her professor for an extension. He shrugged and said it was fine, as long as the report arrived by Monday. That evening, she cooked dinner over a small gas flame and finally felt at ease. With three more days, she made the report her top priority and finished it on Sunday.
items.passageZh: Ming 是一名大學生，她得在星期五前交一份關於種稻的長篇報告。她爺爺一輩子都投入在種植穀物上，所以她選了這個題目。但這份報告比她預期的難，她也很難應付所有的課業。星期三，她向教授要求延期。教授聳聳肩說沒問題，只要報告在星期一前交就好。那天晚上，她用小小的瓦斯爐火煮了晚餐，終於覺得放鬆了。多了三天，她把報告當成第一優先，在星期天完成了。

questions.questionZh: Ming 為什麼選稻米種植當主題？
options: 爺爺一輩子都在種穀物
她以後想開一家米食餐廳
教授指定全班都寫這個題目

items.promptZh: 她搬到新城市後，很快就學會應付一個人的生活。
referenceEn: After she moved to a new city, she soon learned to cope with living alone.
She quickly learned to cope with life on her own after moving to a new city.
rubricZh: cope 的用法，例如 cope with living alone、cope on her own 等
時態合理（例如 moved、learned 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 ease 造一個句子，說說什麼能讓你減輕壓力或放鬆。
referenceEn: A walk in the park helps ease my stress after work.
Listening to music eases my worries before a test.
rubricZh: ease 可當動詞或名詞（例如 ease my stress、feel at ease 等）
時態配合內容（例如 helps、eases 等）
